biography.value: Boggarts ambush from shadows, apply Frightened conditions through Frightful Visage to scatter formation fighters, then close for claw strikes on isolated targets. They are selfish and not suicidal and a Boggart that is clearly losing will attempt to flee. Troublemaker is their most distinctively Fae ability, producing minor environmental sabotage that compounds the chaos of an encounter in ways that are difficult to anticipate.

system.creatureSubtype: Fortune on saves vs charm effects
system.tactics: Boggarts prefer to ambush from shadows, using Frightful Visage to scatter formation fighters before closing. They are selfish but not suicidal — a Boggart that is clearly losing will attempt to flee. They make poor bodyguards and excellent shock troops for a single terrifying moment.
system.attacksNotes:
Claws [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 6 + Melee Combat 2), Reach: 5 ft

  • Margin 1:: 9 damage (5 + 4 Str)
  • Margin 2: 9 damage, DR halved (round up)
  • Margin 3: 9 damage, DR halved (round up); target makes Will [Easy] save or gains Frightened condition for 1 round.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Frightful Visage: As a [Combat] action, the Boggart distorts its face into something deeply wrong. One creature within 30 feet that can see it makes a Will save opposed by the Boggart's Cha 2 + Intimidate 3 (total 5). On failure, target gains the Frightened condition until end of their next turn. Shadow Meld: In dim light or darkness, the Boggart has Fortune on Stealth checks. Troublemaker: Once per encounter, the Boggart can spend 1 minute interacting with an unattended object to sabotage it in a minor way; a door latch that sticks, a buckle that releases under pressure, a torch that goes out at the worst moment. The GM determines when the sabotage activates. The Boggart cannot sabotage magical items.
